Her Choice. Our Tribute.

A Touch of Fuchsia

Long before we began planning this celebration, our mother shared a special wish.

Like many mothers and daughters, we sometimes had conversations about things neither of us wanted to imagine. Mom had a way of bringing humor into even the most uncomfortable moments.

But one thing she made perfectly clear: when her time came, she wanted to be laid to rest in fuchsia.

Not black. Not white. Fuchsia.

And if you knew our mother, you knew she was a woman who knew what she wanted.

Fuchsia is often associated with vibrancy, confidence, and love. But to our family, its meaning is much more personal. It represents her voice, her individuality, and a wish she entrusted to us.

Throughout her celebration, you’ll notice subtle touches of fuchsia in the floral arrangements and memorial details. Each is an intentional tribute to her.

The color was her choice. Honoring it is ours.

A respectful tribute

Attire & Color Guidance

Our immediate family will wear black in honor of Mom, allowing the beautiful fuchsia she selected to remain uniquely hers.

Family and friends are welcome to wear respectful funeral attire. We kindly ask that guests avoid fuchsia dresses or predominantly fuchsia outfits, as this color has been reserved as a special tribute to Lynda.

With gratitude,
The Family of Lynda Marie Jones

As you make your plans

Guest Information

A few details to help you join us.

Where may I send flowers, cards, or letters?

Address your delivery to Lynda Jones Memorial Service, Embassies of Christ, 4285 Cleveland Street, Gary, IN 46408. View the full mailing information. Please confirm floral receiving instructions before arranging a delivery.

When should I arrive?

Visitation and viewing begin at 10:00 AM CT. The funeral service begins at 11:00 AM CT. Please allow time to arrive and be seated.

What time zone should I use?

Gary is on Central Time, one hour behind Indianapolis. Visitation is 10:00 AM CT (11:00 AM ET); the funeral service is 11:00 AM CT (12:00 PM ET).

What should I wear?

Our immediate family will wear black in honor of Mom. Other guests are welcome to wear respectful funeral attire. Please avoid fuchsia dresses or predominantly fuchsia outfits, reserving that color as a special tribute to Lynda.

Is the graveside open to everyone?

Yes, to family and friends.

How do I get to the cemetery?

Find the cemetery address and Google Maps or Apple Maps directions in Plan Your Visit.

What should I expect at the cemetery?

The graveside is outdoors in late November. Dress warmly and wear sturdy shoes.
